caption:
First time on skates. Nobody needs to know that.

#newyorkcity #iceskating #wollmanrink
alt_text: On a sunlit Central Park ice rink, with snowy trees and the skyline behind, a woman of polished marble with gold veins skates in white skates with her arms open in a blue-grey turtleneck and wide trousers while two people watch from the rail.
